definition: Measured pipeline coverage and structural QA, NOT independently verified price accuracy
limitations: Primary summaries collapse settings, billing classes, modifiers and plans. Do not rank them as equivalent treatment bundles.
Raw payer strings and plan identity are lost in legacy summary layer. New normalized records preserve them.
A parser success is not confirmation that a hospital published correct prices.
Insurer catalogs and CMS benchmarks are separate layers and do not increase primary local price coverage.
No claim of best-in-world accuracy, completeness or freshness is supported.
